items.raw_excerpt: House hunters in the Netherlands are still being pressured to raise their offers and kept in the dark about rival bids, according to almost 1,000 complaints logged since February by home owners’ association Vereniging Eigen Huis (VEH). The association’s complaints hotline, which it reopened in February after a five-year gap, received 921 reports from buyers and sellers by early July, broadcaster NOS reported. items.summary_en: Home buyers in the Netherlands have filed almost 1,000 complaints about being pressured to raise their offers. The complaints were logged by a home owners' association that reopened its hotline in February. Buyers say they were kept in the dark about rival bids and pushed toward higher prices.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 주택 구매자들이 입찰 가격을 올리도록 압박당했다는 항의가 1,000건 가까이 접수됐다. 주택 소유자 협회는 온라인 상담 창구를 올해 2월 다시 열었고, 7월 초까지 921건의 신고가 들어왔다. 구매자들은 경쟁 입찰 정보를 제대로 받지 못하고 더 높은 가격을 요구받았다고 호소하고 있다.
items.title_en: Home buyers file nearly 1,000 complaints over unfair bidding

items.raw_excerpt: The Danish discount retailer Normal is continuing to expand across Portugal, with its latest shop now open in Caldas da Rainha.
items.summary_en: Danish discount retailer Normal is expanding across Portugal. Its latest shop is now open in Caldas da Rainha. The store adds to the company's growing presence in the country.

items.raw_excerpt: Boh Geh Uncle Canteen, an open-air eatery on the grounds of a former Royal Air Force base in northern Singapore, will serve its final meal on Sept. 18 and close permanently the next day after 57 years.
items.summary_en: Boh Geh Uncle Canteen, an open-air eatery on a former Royal Air Force base in northern Singapore, will serve its final meal on September 18. The beloved local spot will close permanently the next day after 57 years.
